title: Motor
definition: An electromechanical device that converts electrical energy into mechanical energy, operating primarily on the fundamental principles of electromagnetism, specifically Lorentz force and electromagnetic induction.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for Science & Technology (GS-3: Applications of Science, Emerging Technologies, Energy Infrastructure, Electric Mobility, and Industrial Automation). Frequently tested in Prelims via core physics principles (Fleming's rules, induction) and application-based tech (BLDC motors, EV propulsion).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of AC, DC, and BLDC motors.
Evaluate spatial distribution, manufacturing ecosystems, and national policy dimensions like FAME and PLI schemes.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions regarding motor types and electromagnetic rules.
